_comment: Shrink-only ratchet. Every number here may fall and may not rise;
a file absent from a section may not appear in it.
--update-baseline, and only when the totals have gone DOWN.
EXCEPTION: four loc entries were raised once, on 2026-08-27, with the
owner's sign-off. Each rise is recorded in _raised below with the reason
and the number it replaced. A rise with no entry there is a regression,
not a decision -- put the lines back rather than editing this file.

_why: The upstream merge (1e383fe) added nine supervised subsystems plus a
set of upstream features. Four baselined files grew. The alternative
to raising these four was moving close-path code (close_trade and its
callers in runtime.py), which is frozen and needs a demo session.
The owner chose the raise.
Every other file in this ratchet still holds its original floor, and
ea_bridge.py was SPLIT rather than baselined (1947 -> 715) instead of
being added here. The sql section went 56 statements -> 0 in the same
series. This is four recorded exceptions, not a general reset.

why: The merge added nine methods to TradingRuntime: six supervisor loops
(_auto_template, _closed_market_queue, _ea_link_watchdog,
_ref_backfill, _signal_snapshot, _revalidate_pending_orders) plus
close_cmd, schedule_profit_sync and _await_trade_promotion.
The class is 88 methods averaging 12 lines, so returning to 1310
means deleting ~16 whole methods. The largest remaining are
_close_full_after_tps (53) and _cmd_close (45), both close-path.
Two loop bodies WERE relocated into their services first
(auto-template and signal snapshot, 1569 -> 1509) with 20 new tests
on logic that had none. The rest is not reachable without touching
frozen code.
facade_baseline.json rose from 79 to 88 for the same nine methods --
the two numbers are one fact stated twice and must move together.
THE LEAST COMFORTABLE OF THE FOUR, recorded as such deliberately.
This is licence-key issuance (Ed25519 signing through a
KeyGen-registered callback), the Telegram approve-registration
buttons, and per-client build tracking.
It has ZERO tests. That is also why it sits on the blocked-on-tests
list in docs/system/rules/70-file-organisation.md rather than in the
split queue.
Raising this baseline buys nothing but a green gate. It does not
make the file safer, and it removes the one signal that would have
flagged the next unreviewed growth in the code that issues licences
and grants admin authority.
The tests are deferred, not cancelled -- docs/todo/testing/012.
When they land, this entry should come back down.
Three execution-affecting settings joined the cross-node sync list:
internal_hedge_mode, internal_net_exposure_max_lots and
re_learn_from_ref_signals. Whichever node is the active trader reads
these before executing, so a flag set on one side that never reaches
the other is a live divergence between what the operator set and
what actually trades. Each entry carries its own comment.
A PII fix, not growth. The MT5 connect log carried the account
number, the broker server and the balance, and the diagnostics
feature uploads ~3,000 raw log lines to the admin server -- so every
one of them carried it (Q005 #1 in
docs/simon-handover/005-fact-finding.md, confirmed from real
captured logs). Seven of the nine lines are the comment recording
that. Deleting them to satisfy a line count would be the wrong
trade. The file is exempt from splitting anyway: it runs under a
different interpreter.

_why: Found while checking that the four raises above sat exactly on reality
rather than leaving slack. Three entries had drifted the OTHER way:
the files shrank and nobody lowered their number, so the ratchet was
holding a ceiling well above the code and could not have caught
regrowth up to it. Lowering is always permitted by the rule at the top
of this file, so these needed no sign-off.
backend/src/db/database.py            1251 -> removed (now 457)
backend/src/services/cluster/remote/client.py  920 -> 894
frontend/pages/test_panel.py         1246 -> 1245
database.py is DELETED from the section rather than lowered: at 457 it
is under the 800 ceiling entirely, so it is no longer a violation, and
a file absent from a section may not reappear in it. That is stricter
than any number would be -- it can never cross 800 again without
failing the gate. It had 794 lines of headroom before this.
The lesson is the one CLAUDE.md already states: green output is not
evidence. This gate was green on those three files because its ceiling
was too high to touch, not because the files were healthy.
Five loc entries removed and one lowered. Lowering and removing are
always permitted by the rule at the top of this file, so none of
this needed sign-off.
backend/src/services/cluster/remote/client.py   894 -> removed (732)
backend/src/services/cluster/sync/client.py     867 -> removed (744)
backend/src/services/cluster/sync/server.py    1085 -> removed (721)
frontend/pages/ai_trade_analysis.py           1250 -> removed (package)
frontend/pages/test_panel.py                  1245 -> removed (package)
backend/src/runtime.py                        1509 -> 1507
The three cluster files are now UNDER the 800 ceiling, so they are
no longer violations at all and are held to the same ceiling as
every other file -- stricter than any number, since a file absent
from a section may never reappear in it. Note that removes the
sync/server.py entry from _raised's scope in practice: its 2026-08-27
rise is history now, and the record above stays as the account of
what was decided at the time.
The two frontend entries named files that no longer exist. Both
became packages, and a baseline entry for a deleted path is a number
the gate can never check.
The transaction section also dropped from three entries to one:
reversal_engine/database.py (3) and test_signal/database.py (1) are
resolved. backend/src/db/database.py (1) remains, and is the schema
builder.
Found while reconciling the refactor trackers against the code. The
same pass found that --update-baseline itself DELETED this whole
record -- _comment, _raised and _tightened all rebuilt from a literal
-- so running the command this file documents destroyed the reason
its numbers are what they are. Fixed in the same change, with tests.
